topic.title: Bhangarh Fort: no entry after sunset
topic.angle: An official ASI board forbids entry before sunrise and after sunset; two curse legends (the sadhu's shadow, the sorcerer and the princess); history says war and famine emptied the town
key_facts: Bhangarh Fort is in Alwar district, Rajasthan, built in the 16th/17th century (attributed to Raja Bhagwant Das)
Legend: the sadhu Guru Balu Nath allowed the town on condition that no shadow of the palace fell on his place; when it did, the town was cursed
Legend: a sorcerer who desired princess Ratnavati died cursing the town
An Archaeological Survey of India board at the gate forbids entry before sunrise and after sunset
Historians link the town's decline to war and famine
sources: Archaeological Survey of India (Bhangarh monument board)
